newsitem.title: ITALY: Montedison says 96.7 pct warrants exercised.
newsitem.headline: Montedison says 96.7 pct warrants exercised.

text.p: Italian agri-industrial group Montedison said 96.7 percent of 1994-1997 warrants had been exercised, with subscription totalling 1.037 trillion lire worth of shares.
A statement from the group said provisional figures showed 2.802 billion warrants had been exercised compared with 2.898 billion in circulation on December 1, 1996.
The deadline for presentation for subscription requests to Montedison ordinary shares was December 30, 1996.
Subscriptions for ordinary shares, at the ratio of 37 for every 100 warrants, totalled 1.037 billion for a total of 1.037 trillion lire, Montedison said.
The new shares will be issued on January 17 and will have dividends payable from January 1, 1996.
Montedison's share capital increases to 5.716 trillion lire, according to the provisional data, with 5.716 billion shares of which 4.98 billion are ordinary shares.
